game: Sidereal Confluence: Trading and Negotiation in the Elysian Quadrant

included: All claims and important core procedures in frozen summary
Entire original ten-page 2017 rulebook, extracted text and native rendering of every page
All nine original species fronts and Faderan reverse
Every manifest image, full accepted printed relic deck reverse, full accepted parent atlases, associated crop images
Direct contemporaneous designer posts 26690049 and26803262 with raw article author records and matching author profile
excluded: Optional Timed Trading, Handicapping and Precise Resource Scoring variants
Other users’ statements/quotations as independent rules authority
Community module scripts/behavior and unused candidate components as rules authority
Memorization of all physical converter input/output quantities; summary properly defers these to printed cards
scope.authority_policy: Printed original components supply rules; metadata supplies lineage only. Direct identified 2017 designer posts clarify original final-turn ambiguity.

data_read: Actual associated provenance and image parents needed for independent source/crop lineage verification
not_read: Root progress or other task reports
independent_input_declaration.writes: Only this source-audit.json in the repository; temporary renders and audit computation files under /tmp/sidereal-audit05.

conclusion: No factual error or important missing core procedural content found within the original-2017 base/all-nine-species scope. Final-turn order, bonuses, scoring, species exceptions and accepted original relic component details agree with the inspected original sources.

coverage.summary_section: Front matter, Overview, Components, Reading resources and cards
coverage.assessment: Original edition identity, 4–9 players/120 minutes, six-turn goal, point privacy, nominal values, resource sizes/colors, entry symbols, card ownership backgrounds, unbounded supply and listed components agree. Species screen/card wording does not change printed quantities.

Species selection, starting holdings from printed species cards, starred cards, libraries, colony/research orientation and shuffling, era order, dealing direction, Kjas colony-track player count and species setup exceptions agree. Faderan example exactly matches original booklet p.3.

original_source_evidence.locator: complete direct designer explanation of final turn

coverage.assessment: Five ordinary economies plus one normal scoring-only economy; six Trades; post-Economy final sharing without bidding; no seventh Trade; final bonuses and final Zeth theft agree. End-turn loans and card advancement agree with p.9.

Multilateral/contingent/future promises, consent, compensation, exact default penalty table, negative points, loan returns, permanent unbackgrounded transfers, Trade end trigger and limited negotiation timing agree.

Alternative research inputs, invention points and immediate own card, delayed sharing, out-of-play entry exception, borrower resource-paid violet upgrade, both-owned-in-play named-card payment, hidden spent card identity, renamed upgrades, colony flipping, climate costs and normal/nullspace discard destinations agree. The owner-possession sentence in p.6 belongs to the named-card alternative as represented.

Support check at Economy start, optional white converters normally once, simultaneous payment including ships/points, no output chaining/negotiation, donation isolation and next-Trade disposal, final retention, sharing bonus placement, unique era IV and Yengii exceptions agree.

Announce total ships, independently commit both bids and retain pile, colony then research reveals, full-bid spending/pass retention, current relevant-card ties and final species priority, Kjas split, Kt/Yengii exceptions, restricted binding negotiation, minimum-1 disposal/leftward refill and no flipping agree.

Separate complete resource groups produce half points: each octagon, each two large, each three small/ships combined; add earned points, half-point precision, no tiebreaker. Optional precise scoring is expressly excluded.

Halved nonrounded colony bids only; seedling on starting/bid-track colony only; simultaneous twice-running economic converter, upgrade unaffected, token retained on flip/trade and removed on discard; immediate violet upgrade output agree.

original_source_evidence.locator: Interest Converters and Unity Wild Resources

coverage.assessment: Own-interest prohibition including upgrades, same-color input/output, gray-wild passthrough without creation, one ordinary remainder color, mixed ordinary/wild input, and worked 2-to-4 example agree.

original_source_evidence.locator: all eight printed relic exception sections
complete front supplies clipped outer text
full printed relic deck reverse converter

coverage.assessment: Token holder permissions and per-invention return/point; single once-per-turn deck-back converter; four small white plus ice colony input; deck entry rewards; relic lending and exceptions; Transport support/colonies/point and Im’dril exception; Cache rounded-up points and mandatory cube reduction; Paradise Trade conversion; Star’s Ruin sharing bonus; Gift first-trade/nonreturn rule; Grindstone point input; Relic Detector no-trade rule and separate relic route; Decomposer simultaneous ship input all agree. Ordinary card converter quantities remain on actual cards by declared scope.

Allocation and combining fleet support, sufficient fleets accompanying loans, borrowed converters without support symbols, Trade fleet discovery/point/starred fleet and zero ordinary colony support with Transport exception agree.

Split at original purchase opportunity, equal-as-possible halves and later ranks, purchase/pass retention per half, no repeat splitting, changed colony count tiebreak, setup double counting and card-like enter/flip/loan territory tiles agree.

original_source_evidence.locator: Nonlinear Thinking diagram and all procedural paragraphs

coverage.assessment: Three depicted fixed pairs, independent upgrades and paired loans, top Trade colony-entry converter, permanent colony transfers, consumed nullspace removal, unlimited colony support, special colony-count priority and infinite final tiebreak agree.

Wild colors within size, no immediate conversion, different color choices, theft immunity, Eni Et passthrough, arbitrary same-sized inputs, any-climate consumption, four initially absent computer worlds and one ordinary support agree.

Private invention and public benefit, separate splay, reduced bonus, invented-card exclusion for bid ties, traded permanent licenses including same Trade, and no restoration of spent upgrade payment agree.

Whole Envoys output/token bundle, token trade/gift restrictions, red converters after Confluence, alternative input payment, single target per converter/no double target, partial theft, size/shape only, envoy cost discount without consumption, gray immunity and explicit trade versus gift protection all agree.

FAQ accurately distinguishes mandatory original rules from the designer’s optional house-rule suggestion. Correct final input colors, simultaneous output, retained donations, scoring formulas, fifth Economy as final invention funding production, final sharing and theft all agree; reference repeats the checked procedures consistently.

visual_lineage_assessment.species_facsimiles: All nine fronts match the corresponding artwork, typography, layout and visible text in the 2017 nine-species image; Faderan front additionally agrees with full 2019 photo. Cropped Faderan front outer text was read in the separate complete photograph.
visual_lineage_assessment.confluence_components: Full front/back atlases show original cards; booklet p.4 bonus fronts and p.9 Turn2 reverse agree with recovered original atlas typography, numbers and phase list. All15 recorded crop transforms reproduce parent pixels exactly.
visual_lineage_assessment.relic_components: Full original front atlas includes printed rule text and relic-deck corner; full accepted reverse agrees with that deck converter and with rulebook p.2 example and Faderan single-converter rule.
visual_lineage_assessment.historical_filename_note: component-9-back.jpg is actual PNG, as stated by frozen manifest. Recovered provenance retains a stale generic JPEG-extension note, but exact SHA256/SHA1/dimensions agree with actual PNG bytes; no rules discrepancy results.
